title: Highly reversible zinc anode enabled by a trace-amount additive with pH buffering capability
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,982-990
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04870A, Paper
Xiaohui Ma, Qiong Wang, Xi Zhang, Yu Lin, Fengyi Zhang, Jianhang Huang, Yonggang Wang
Trace-amount additive (10 mM, 0.1 wt%), ammonium succinate, was introduced to endow electrolyte with excellent pH buffering ability, resulting in high CE (99.91% and 99%) at low current density (1 mA cm−2 and 0.5 mA cm−2) and high cycle stability.
